repeatability.compared: stable projection of the two runs
repeatability.note: The digest is OBSERVED, not asserted: it is computed over the sorted (check_id, disposition_id) set and the disposition is inserted fresh inside each run, so two runs may legitimately differ. A difference here is not a failure; a difference in the stable projection is.

permit_invariant.why: the four beats run inside ONE transaction that is rolled back. If that is true, the committed permit is unchanged afterwards, and open_blocking in particular is still 1 rather than the 0 the signed disposition would leave behind.

defeater_vocab_literal.why: the constant both signing paths bound until 2026-08-14, and the value the deployed Cloud recorded on its one signed disposition. Recomputed here rather than quoted so the comparison is reproducible.

signature_path.why_no_mutating_request: POST /v1/checks/{check_id}/disposition commits irreversibly and is refused 423 demo_subject_write_protected on the seeded demo subject; evidence/deploy/demo-guard-armed.json measured that guard firing. A probe whose safety depends on a guard holding is a probe that writes on the day it does not, and the row it would write closes the demo's one obligation for every judge after it. The signature is observed at beat 4 instead, where it is rolled back.

negative_control.claim: a digest read from each check's own rows differs between checks; a constant cannot

signature_path.not_established_here: the gate-run payload does not publish beat 4's defeater_code or its bound defeater_vocab_sha256, so 'the digest the signature pinned equals the digest these rows carry' is NOT established by this credential-free caller. It is asserted in-process by verticals/mainline/apps/demo-api/tests/test_judge_can_sign.py. What beat 4 answering 'admitted' DOES establish is that the vocabulary resolved at all: an absent one raises DefeaterVocabularyAbsent and the request is 422 demo_history_not_seeded, never a 200.

row_census.why: POST /v1/demo/gate-run is allowed to be driven against a shared live database BECAUSE it is savepoint-fenced and rolls back, and that permission is conditional on this reading. A run that moved these counts has broken the demo for the next judge and says so here rather than being re-seeded over.

advisories: the target answered with x-mainline-emulator: local_furl. This run was taken against scripts/deploy/local_furl.py — the REAL demo-api handler and the REAL console bundle, over a local socket, against the database named under /v1/health. It proves the handler, the site and the gate. It does NOT prove that a public demo URL exists; docs/submission/SUBMISSION.json holds UNRESOLVED until one does.

/v1/health reports migrations_applied=0, and that is a true count of the wrong ledger rather than a broken deployment. health.py's statement counts trappoint.schema_migration WHERE state='applied'; the only writer of that table in the tree is trappoint_migrate/runner.py:295, i.e. `trappoint migrate up`. This database was built by scripts/deploy/cloud_chain.py, which bootstraps the attestation ledger (hence the non-null schema_fingerprint above) and then applies the 271 files itself, recording its count in trappoint.deploy_chain instead. So schema_migration is empty by construction, 0 is honest about it, and the chain really is applied — the schema_fingerprint above is the identifier that moves when the schema does. Two appliers, two ledgers, and /v1/health reads only one of them.

http_hop.what_that_means: the flag `target_is_local_emulator` is read from a header the target sent and describes the SOCKET only. A true value means no public demo URL was reached; it says nothing about which database answered underneath.

database_under_test.how: GET /v1/health names the database the handler is connected to, with no credential involved. The census names the database it selected BY NAME and confirmed with SELECT current_database(). Two independent readings, and the field above records whether they agree.

target_provenance.not_established_by_this_run: that a public demo URL exists. The stack is unapplied — `aws lambda get-function --function-name mainline-demo-api` answers ResourceNotFoundException — and no acceptance run can conjure one. docs/submission/SUBMISSION.json holds UNRESOLVED until it does.

note:
THE LOCAL REPRODUCTION, ON 2026-08-14 (TRAPPOINT), AT TREE d098721 (master) PLUS THIS WAVE'S UNCOMMITTED WORKING TREE. Measured with git status at the moment of this run, three files under the handler's own distribution were modified and not yet committed: mainline_demo_api/gate_run.py, retry.py and transitions.py. THAT IS NOT A FOOTNOTE - gate_run.py is the module the four beats live in, so this transcript is a measurement of the wave's working tree and not of HEAD. It is stated here because an evidence file that names a commit and was taken against something else is the class of claim this repository exists to refuse; the same run against a clean checkout of d098721 has not been taken and is not claimed. THIS FILE REPLACES THE 2026-08-13 RUN THAT STOOD HERE AND SAID "NOT PROVEN". That run was taken against a local emulator over a local database, its beat 4 was REFUSED 23503 disposition_signer_credential_id_fkey ten times, and it was the first thing a judge reading evidence/ found: the project's own acceptance evidence saying the demo does not work. The defect it named is fixed - gate_run.py now RESOLVES signer_credential_id and countersigner_credential_id from mainline.signing_credential by signer_sub instead of deriving them, and resolves the defeater vocabulary digest from mainline.defeater_option instead of binding sha256(b'defeater-vocab') - and this run is the same program against the same shape of database with nothing else changed. All four beats complete.

WHY THERE ARE NOW TWO ACCEPTANCE ARTEFACTS AND NEITHER IS A COPY OF THE OTHER. evidence/deploy/cloud-acceptance.json records the same four beats against the DEPLOYED CockroachDB Cloud database mainline_demo, which is what the demo will actually meet. This file records the LOCAL reproduction, which is what a stranger with this repository and a Docker CockroachDB can run for themselves. Cloud is authoritative for what the demo must carry; local is authoritative for what is reproducible. Neither was edited to match the other, and if they ever disagree that disagreement is the finding and both stay.

WHAT ANSWERED. scripts/deploy/local_furl.py serving the UNMODIFIED mainline_demo_api.app.handler over an emulated Lambda Function URL payload-2.0 event, with the real console dist and the demo-cloud EvidenceBundle staged under /bundle/. NO MONKEYPATCHING: nothing of this run's own is imported into the handler's process, which is the thing the 2026-08-13 artefact could only achieve with a scratchpad wrapper. DATABASE: w_w3 on the pinned local CockroachDB v26.2.5 node at 127.0.0.1:26257, seeded by scripts/deploy/seed_demo.py from verticals/mainline/db/seeds/demo/demo_world.sql and demo_permit.sql - THE SAME TWO FILES THAT SEEDED CockroachDB Cloud mainline_demo, chosen for exactly that reason. seed_demo.py's own verifier reported SEEDED AND REFUSABLE, state=dispositioned open_blocking=1 gate_epoch=1 head_seq=2, MERGE REFUSED [23514] gate_closed_when_issued, rollback nothing_persisted=True. MAINLINE_DEMO_ALLOW_MUTATION was unset, so transitions._demo_guard was armed.

THE CENSUS IS CHECKED AGAINST THE CLOUD ARTEFACT ON PURPOSE, AND ON ITS FIRST USE IT FOUND SOMETHING. The expected row counts come from evidence/deploy/cloud-seed.json - the transcript of the DEPLOYED database - rather than from this database's own seed transcript. Two seed files, two clusters, one expected shape: if the local reproduction and the deployed demo carried different counts from the same two files, that difference is a finding about the seeds and it should surface here rather than be invisible. IT DID. The first run of this capture reported drift on exactly two tables - mainline.ledger_checkpoint expected 3 observed 2, mainline.cosignature expected 3 observed 2 - and the cause was measured rather than assumed. demo_world.sql inserts exactly TWO checkpoints, tree_size 2 and tree_size 4, each guarded by NOT EXISTS, and two matching cosignatures. Its own section header, at demo_world.sql:391, says what used to be there: "Until 2026-08-14 this section seeded ONE checkpoint, tree_size = 1, with a root_hash of digest('mainline-demo/ledger/root/1','sha256') - a hash of a STRING NAMING ITSELF - over a mainline.ledger_leaf that held zero rows." Read-only on Cloud today the checkpoints are tree_size 1, 2 and 4 over 4 leaves, and for tree_size 1 the root_hash IS digest('mainline-demo/ledger/root/1','sha256') while for 2 and 4 it is not. So the deployed database still carries the LEGACY row that no current seed writes and that the re-seed did not delete, and cloud-seed.json's 3 and 3 are the count of a database with legacy rows rather than the output of the seed files.

WHICH SIDE MOVED, AND WHY THAT ONE WAS DERIVED. The expected values for these two tables are supplied to this run as --census-extra mainline.ledger_checkpoint=2 and mainline.cosignature=2, with the SEED FILE named as their authority. That is the authoritative side: what these two files write is what a database seeded from them must carry, and demo_world.sql:691-762 writes two of each. cloud-seed.json's 3 and 3 is derived - it is a reading of one particular database whose history includes a row the seeds no longer produce - and it is not edited here, because it remains a true count of that database and evidence/deploy/cloud-acceptance.json checks Cloud against it and passes. Two objects, two true numbers, and the difference between them recorded rather than reconciled by moving one. The other three counts (defeater_option 6, ledger_leaf 4, ledger_node 3) are supplied with commit 7535670's own message as their authority, because cloud-seed.json's row_counts does not carry those tables at all.

WHAT THIS RUN DOES NOT PROVE. That a public demo URL exists - target_is_local_emulator is true and the X-Mainline-Emulator header is why. That the deployed cluster behaves this way - evidence/deploy/cloud-acceptance.json is the artefact for that, and it is the one the submission should cite for the demo. And it does not prove that beat 4's signature pinned the digest these vocabulary rows carry, because the gate-run payload does not publish the digest it bound; see cloud-acceptance.json's signature_path.not_established_here.

NOTHING WAS RELAXED TO REACH THIS GREEN AND NO FIELD OF THIS FILE WAS HAND-EDITED. It is the output of scripts/deploy/demo_acceptance.py, written by the program at the end of the run whose command is recorded under invocation. No floor was lowered, no ceiling raised, no assertion weakened, no seed or fixture moved to match code, no entry added to qa/cluster-known-red.json. No credential was printed anywhere; the local DSN recorded below carries no password because the local node has none.
